summary: The Ramazan occurrence is an experiencer-centered Detransitive calming event in a desired-result clause; the person speaking to him is not a grammatical actor of hydn.

JTM 5.2/45 has a genuine calming predicate with horses as participants, but the unprefixed hadini cannot yet establish a dialectal hydn form. A hadin search found no parallel and hdn has no entry in the supplied lookup.
Identify the lemma and paradigm of hadini at JTM 5.2/45. Is this a separate hdn verb, or a phonological variant of hydn?
If hadini belongs here, confirm its stem, Detransitive status and the relation of its plural ending to mhaydən. No example was added on semantic similarity alone.
